records.summary: Nvidia's board has reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO and board director, reversing his resignation weeks earlier after an espionage scandal that wiped out more than $1 trillion in market value.
records.title: NVIDIA Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO and Board Director

records.summary: US intelligence agencies had tracked the Nvidia scandal figure's ties to Chinese intelligence for more than a year before Jensen Huang's resignation, according to new reporting on the episode.
records.title: US spies tracked Nvidia scandal figure's ties to Chinese intelligence for over a year

records.summary: Walmart's new Agent Gateway launches with support for Meta's Muse agent, letting the AI shop for Black Friday deals on a user's behalf.
records.title: Meta Muse can do your Black Friday shopping at Walmart

records.summary: Z.ai released GLM-5.4, its first flagship model built on a Loop Transformer that runs 28 layers of the GLM-5 base model twice, claiming intelligence comparable to 2-3 trillion-parameter models with added vision and a 1M-token context.
records.title: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer

records.summary: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki discussed how AI development could be deliberately limited, weighing in on the debate over slowing frontier model progress.
records.title: OpenAI's chief scientist has thoughts on how to limit AI development

records.summary: A Wall Street Journal profile surfaced old Slack messages in which Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei floated immersive video games as a way to ease the political strife caused by AI-driven joblessness.
records.title: video games are the opiate of the masses

records.summary: The UK AI Security Institute found a universal jailbreak against pre-release GPT-6.2 Astra using half as many queries as it needed for GPT-6 Astra; OpenAI says it has since changed the model's safeguards, though the institute has not yet retested them.
records.title: OpenAI's pre-release GPT-6.2 Astra was easier to jailbreak than its predecessor, UK government testers found

records.summary: Researchers show how a backdoored open model can be triggered by a single word to take malicious actions, and how ViKernel's action-level checks can catch the attack before it executes.
records.title: A Model You Downloaded, Backdoored: One Trigger Word, and ViKernel Stops It at the Action

records.summary: Vero Security raised $11 million in seed funding and launched AISecurityEngineering.org, a free community for the people tasked with governing enterprise AI agents.
records.title: Vero raises $11M to shape AI Security Engineering

records.summary: A new ViKernel Scanner benchmark gave 20 open-weight models shell access and every one failed the security test, showing how easily downloaded models can be tricked into running malicious actions.
records.title: We Handed 20 Open Models a Shell. 20 of Them Failed: Introducing ViKernel Scanner

records.summary: ResolveAI launched SRE-1, a 27B open-weights model trained with reinforcement learning to trace production alerts to their root cause, alongside a Primary On-call service that puts AI agents first in the incident paging chain.
records.title: ResolveAI Introduces SRE-1, the Most Accurate Model for Production at Every Budget

records.summary: Notable Capital, GIC and Baillie Gifford placed outsized early bets on Anthropic that have paid off many times over after its record IPO, with GIC alone investing more than $4.5 billion across three funding rounds.
records.title: How Notable Capital, GIC, and Baillie Gifford bet big on Anthropic before its IPO

records.summary: A new open-source tool that runs agentic coding locally on a Mac with a single command.
records.title: Localcode, open source agentic coding on your Mac with one command

records.summary: A hands-on beginner's guide to running AI models locally using Inkling, Qwen and Unsloth tooling.
records.title: A Beginner's Guide to Local AI with Inkling, Qwen, and Unsloth

records.summary: An indie game that puts the player in the role of an LLM's subagent, carrying out delegated tasks for a larger model.
records.title: Show HN: I built a game where you are an LLM's subagent

records.summary: Dragos planted about two million fake credentials in AI prompts and found three inference providers compromised, with attackers stealing AWS keys; OpenRouter removed three providers and 125 endpoints from zero-data-retention eligibility.
records.title: Security researchers show how cheap AI inference providers steal keys and snoop on users

records.summary: Signal is blocking screenshots in its Android and iOS apps, saying OS-level AI agents that scan screens undermine its ability to guarantee message privacy.
records.title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts 'existential threat' of AI surveillance

records.summary: Cognition launched Devin Bots, persistent AI agents that manage teams of Devin coding agents over multi-week projects; its showcase Android app took 44 days and 1,134 merged pull requests.
records.title: Devin Bots: Cognition's Persistent Coding Agents Explained

records.summary: In an interview about his book 'Hyperscale,' journalist Paris Marx argues AI data centers have become the most visible, bipartisan flashpoint of the tech backlash because their costs in power, water and noise land directly on local communities.
records.title: Why data centers are at the center of the Big Tech backlash

records.summary: OpenAI argues perplexity should become a shared yardstick for tracking pretraining progress across labs, publishing its own internal measurements and proposing common development limits tied to concrete safety milestones.
records.title: Perplexity and Intelligence

records.summary: MOSI, the Shanghai startup spun out of Fudan University professor Qiu Xipeng's OpenMOSS team, closed a Pre-A round of more than RMB 1 billion (about $140 million) led by Huakong Fund. The company has shipped more than 20 open-source speech, vision, and multimodal models in the first half of 2026 and is preparing to launch MOSS Live, a real-time omni-modal interaction system.
records.title: MOSI Pre-A Funding: Fudan MOSS Team Raises Over RMB 1 Billion for Omni-Modal Real-Time AI

records.summary: After canary-token research by Dragos found prompt data compromised or retained by some inference providers, OpenRouter off-boarded three providers, stripped 125 endpoints of Zero Data Retention eligibility, and notified affected customers. OpenRouter itself was not breached; provider notices from Novita, Phala and Together AI describe the underlying incidents.
records.title: Data Processing Incidents on Inference Providers

records.summary: Pandex gives AI agents access to official European law through the Model Context Protocol, letting agents query EU legislation as a tool instead of relying on memorized or hallucinated legal text.
records.title: Pandex – Official European Law for AI Agents, over MCP
The UN fails to agree on rules regulating 'killer robots'
records.summary: UN negotiations ended without agreement on rules to regulate lethal autonomous weapons systems, leaving the fast-moving technology without binding international limits.

The LookAtMyQuant quantization compiler squeezes Thinking Machines Lab's Inkling-2-Mini from 18.89 GB down to a 5.38 GB build (1.63 bits per weight) that runs on Apple Silicon via a custom MLX runtime, retaining about 91% of the teacher model's benchmark performance.
records.title: Inkling-2-Mini in 5.4 GB Memory

records.summary: Microdrama startup Shortical premiered an AI-generated series starring a licensed digital avatar of actor Aki Avni and is now inviting others to license their faces for AI-generated content.
records.title: Is selling an AI version of your face to this microdrama startup the future of Hollywood?

records.summary: The Lean and Mathlib communities jointly certified Levent Alpöge's Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, confirming the statement, the compilation, and the proof's validity with several independent proof checkers.
records.title: Lean verification of the Riemann Hypothesis

records.summary: Together AI discloses that an AI coding agent committed a credential to its public GitHub repository, letting an unauthorized party download stored customer prompt samples from June and July; the company is making zero data retention the default for new accounts.
records.title: Security event: Prompt leakage for requests in June and July of 2026

records.summary: Amazon is in final-stage talks to acquire AI startup Decart for about $7.5 billion, the Financial Times reported, with a deal possibly announced as early as next week. Decart's software helps AI workloads run efficiently across different chips, including Amazon's Trainium hardware.
records.title: Amazon nears $7.5 billion deal to buy AI startup Decart

records.summary: Google CEO Sundar Pichai announced $5 million in support for IIT Kharagpur to advance AI research, education and capacity building. The funding will focus on Indic languages, agriculture, materials science and educational technology.
records.title: Google's $5 million support for IIT Kharagpur to take country's AI-for-all vision forward: CEO Pichai

records.summary: OpenAI made GPT-Live-1.1 available in its API, a full-duplex voice model with more consistent multilingual accents and better task completion, plus a new standby mode that bills idle WebRTC sessions at $0.02 per minute instead of $0.05.
records.title: OpenAI Ships GPT-Live-1.1 for Voice Agents, Cuts Idle Cost to $0.02/Min

records.summary: Given only hex dumps, a frontier model identified, patched, and even wrote working executables from scratch, and correctly analyzed a malware sample's behavior without any disassembler or decompiler.
records.title: Programming in the Machine Code Space: LLMs can read & write executables byte by byte

records.summary: ClawDOS runs an AI coding agent natively on a 1983 IBM PC XT, writing and compiling programs through the Claude API on an 8088 processor with 640K of RAM.
records.title: ClawDOS – An AI coding agent for DOS

records.summary: Microsoft rolls out OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Sol across Copilot Chat, Cowork, Studio and the Office apps, while the heavier Astra model reaches all eligible users only in Cowork and Studio, with Frontier-only access in Chat and Office.
records.title: Available today: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Sol and GPT-6.2 Astra in Microsoft Copilot

records.summary: In a 12-week experiment, 936 autonomous AI agents across 35 human-run labs published 936 papers on a shared preprint server, exchanged 9,500 messages, and even founded their own peer-review journal. The full archive of papers, code, reviews, and chat logs is now public.
records.title: A Society of AI Scientists

records.summary: Databricks is in early talks to raise several billion dollars in a new round that would value the data and AI software company at about $225 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported. The figure would top the $190 billion valuation from its $5 billion round in August.
records.title: Databricks In Early Talks To Raise Funds At $225 Billion Valuation

records.summary: Etsy said it will revise its new AI policy after sellers pushed back against its rules around AI-generated listings. The marketplace is reworking the policy in response to the backlash from its seller community.
records.title: Etsy says it will revise its new AI policy after backlash from sellers

records.summary: AWS launched SageMaker HyperPod Global Inference Gateway, letting companies serve AI models from a single endpoint spanning multiple regions and clusters. The service aims to simplify large-scale, low-latency model inference across geographies.
records.title: Introducing Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Global Inference Gateway: One endpoint across Regions and clusters
Google rolls out new search homepage with AI chat history and no search button
records.summary: Google is rolling out a redesigned search homepage centered on AI chat history, dropping the traditional search button and adding an AI sidebar.
Meta is re-evaluating its 2030 net-zero goal as emissions from its AI data centers reach record levels, raising the question of whether other tech giants will follow.
records.title: Meta reconsiders 2030 net-zero goal amid record emissions from AI data centers

records.summary: Anthropic rolled out a redesigned Claude mobile app, refreshing its look and navigation. The update follows the recent desktop redesign of the AI assistant.
records.title: Claude has a new mobile design, too

records.summary: U.S. stocks plunged Friday as the AI sell-off deepened: the Nasdaq fell 5.3%, wiping out all its 2026 gains, while Anthropic slid 8.5% on its second day of trading and Nvidia dropped 14%, its worst day in almost two years.
records.title: Nasdaq wipes out gains for the year as Anthropic IPO fails to quell AI nerves

records.summary: A researcher planted two million unique canary secrets into the AI data supply chain and found them resurfacing in model outputs and datasets, showing that secret user data leaks through training-data pipelines at an alarming rate.
records.title: Researcher plants 2m canaries into the AI supply chain. A privacy disaster surfaced.

records.summary: Digger open-sourced OpenComputer, a self-hostable coding agent that works from Slack: mention @Computer in a thread and it runs Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode on its own VM and opens a pull request, with the authors claiming first push in 24 seconds, about 3.3x faster than Devin on their benchmark.
records.title: Show HN: OpenComputer – an open source alternative to Devin

records.summary: Spotify founder Daniel Ek is backing Europa Fusion, a stealth fusion startup founded by former DeepMind researcher Nantas Nardelli that bets on simulation- and data-heavy methods over hardware-first approaches. The pulsed-power fusion venture aims to develop carbon-free power that could help meet AI's growing energy demand.
records.title: Daniel Ek backs AI researcher's fusion power startup. Here's what they're building.

records.summary: Loudoun County, Virginia, home to the world's densest cluster of data centers, is pausing new data center applications, a notable brake on the AI infrastructure buildout.
records.title: Loudoun County is pausing new data center applications

records.summary: OpenAI detailed how it defends GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol against adversarial distillation, cutting the success rate of attacks that extract protected chain-of-thought reasoning from 54.0% to 0.2% in internal red-team tests, using adversarial training, classifiers, API controls and campaign-level account bans.
records.title: Combatting adversarial distillation

records.summary: The SEC is examining potential accounting issues at Nvidia, including a past change to how the company reports regional revenue that removed Singapore from its geographic breakdown, adding a new regulatory front as the chipmaker faces fallout from the Huang scandal.
records.title: Nvidia's accounting is a focus of US SEC investigation, sources say

records.summary: President Trump threatened a large tax on companies that move AI data centers outside the United States, pressuring firms to keep AI infrastructure domestic.
records.title: Trump threatens 'tremendous tax' for moving AI data centers outside the US

records.summary: Stanford mathematician Ravi Vakil hurried out a draft proof of the generalized Riemann Hypothesis by Alessandro Masullo, worked on for years with review by Brian Conrad, after an AI-assisted proof claim from Anthropic's Levent Alpöge was announced the same day. The draft is all-human, and other mathematicians have already flagged issues to check.
records.title: Hurried Announcement: Alessandro Masullo GRH

records.summary: Lenders behind SpaceX's $40 billion chip financing deal reportedly asked that none of the chips be used for its orbital data-center plans, since chips in orbit cannot be repossessed as collateral, a financing hurdle for space-based AI compute.
records.title: Chips can survive the space environment — can their financing?

records.summary: A charity linked to former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is spending $350 million on CoreWeave, the AI cloud provider, tying the ousted chief's philanthropy to AI compute.
records.title: Jensen Huang's charity is spending $350 million on CoreWeave

records.summary: Google's Gemini app can now generate GIFs, adding short animated clips to the app's creative tools.
records.title: Google's Gemini app can now make GIFs

records.summary: Terence Tao assesses the day's twin claimed breakthroughs: the AI-assisted Navier-Stokes blow-up proof, which he says has a readable paper plus Lean formalization, and the Riemann Hypothesis claims, where the AI-assisted artifact is Lean-only and verification has only just begun.
records.title: Unforced Navier-Stokes Singularity and the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis

records.summary: NYU mathematician Tristan Buckmaster and Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge posted a claimed proof that solutions to the unforced 3D Navier-Stokes equations can blow up in finite time, a Millennium Prize problem, backed by a 600,000-line Lean formalization built with heavy help from AI models.
records.title: Finite-time blow-up for the Navier–Stokes equations

records.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, an open-weight family of continuous diffusion language models with 14 checkpoints at 3B and 8B scale that denoise text in a 16-dimensional embedding space instead of generating token by token, with base, instruct, distilled and self-speculative variants.
records.title: NVIDIA AI Releases Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, a Continuous Diffusion Language Model with 14 checkpoints at 3B/8B

records.summary: Tencent has published the weights of its flagship Hy4 model, a 770-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with a roughly one-million-token context window, about two weeks after the model's API debut. The release is under Tencent's own Hy License rather than plain Apache 2.0.
records.title: Tencent releases Hy4 model weights with million-token context

records.summary: Nothing will unveil its first screen-free AI device on December 8, a gadget the company has been teasing as a voice-first recorder.
records.title: Nothing will announce its screen-free AI device on December 8th

records.summary: California's attorney general served Nvidia an investigative subpoena after reports that former CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with a woman the U.S. government believes is a Chinese spy, probing whether advanced chips or confidential information reached China and whether investors were misled.
records.title: California AG subpoenas Nvidia over worries about Huang's ties with China

records.summary: Signal is blocking AI assistants like Gemini and Siri from reading users' screens in its mobile app, extending its screenshot protections to AI agents.
records.title: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen

records.summary: Oracle says it has secured all the funding needed for its roughly $300 billion, five-year computing contract with OpenAI, after a $20 billion capital raise earlier in November, and calls itself the first hyperscaler fully funded for this AI investment cycle. Its Abilene campus is nearly complete and a second gigawatt-scale site in Shackelford County, Texas, is fully permitted.
records.title: Oracle says its OpenAI infrastructure contract is fully funded

records.summary: METR published its Time Horizon 2 evaluation update, finding frontier models keep doubling the length of verifiable coding tasks they can complete about every 3.6 months, reaching up to 27 hours of human-equivalent work, but still fall well short of humans on open-ended tasks that require research judgment. METR warns current public evidence cannot rule out drastic AI R&D acceleration in the next few years.
records.title: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update

records.summary: Anthropic's November 20 release notes bring Claude's computer-use capability, seeing the screen and operating desktop apps, to Team and Enterprise plans in beta, off by default with admin controls including app allow and block lists.
records.title: Computer use (beta) for Team and Enterprise plans

records.summary: Google Research explains how Duplex now runs inside Tasks in Gemini, letting the assistant phone businesses on a user's behalf on Gemini 4 models, with every call disclosed as automated and merchants able to opt out.
records.title: How Google Duplex evolved to also call businesses for you in Gemini

records.summary: Apollo and Goldman Sachs priced about $44 billion of notes to buy Nvidia's next-generation Vera Rubin GPUs for SpaceX's terrestrial compute buildout, billed as the largest GPU financing executed to date.
records.title: Apollo and Goldman Sachs Announce Pricing of $44 Billion SpaceX GPU Financing

records.summary: AMD publishes Nitro-P, a VAE-free pixel-space text-to-image framework, releasing weights and training code; its distilled one-step variant reaches 90 images per second at 512px on a single MI300X GPU.
records.title: Nitro-P: Pixel-Space Text-to-Image via Hierarchical Semantic-to-Pixel Generation

records.summary: Cognition, maker of the Devin AI coding agent, is in talks to raise $2 billion or more at a $75 billion valuation, Bloomberg reported. It would be the company's third funding round of 2026, following a $2 billion Series E at a $48 billion valuation about two months earlier.
records.title: AI coding platform Cognition embarks on new $2B funding round: report

records.summary: Baseten releases bison-1 (31B) and groundhog-1 (26B MoE), open-weight decision models built on Google's Gemma 4 that return calibrated probabilities instead of text. Bison-1 tops the Artificial Analysis Decision Index at 76, and both offer 128k context and image input.
records.title: Meet bison-1 and groundhog-1, frontier American decision models

records.summary: Mistral opens its Asia-Pacific headquarters in Singapore as an extension of its Science Hub, developing sovereign AI models for the public sector, high-tech manufacturing and robotics. The company plans to more than double regional headcount to 200 by 2027.
records.title: Mistral opens Singapore office as an extended science hub for sovereign AI in Asia Pacific

records.summary: OpenAI's new GPT-6.2 family regressed on SimpleBench: Astra fell to 77.3%, below the 83.7% human baseline and 6.3 points under its predecessor, while Sol dropped 13 points to 69.9%, trailing even the older GPT-6.1 Terra.
records.title: GPT-6.2 Astra drops below the human baseline on SimpleBench, and Sol falls 13 points

records.summary: Runway says coding agents drove 38% of its merged pull requests in October, and nearly every merged pull request in its App Studio codebase was written by agents, with AI review approving most merges on its own.
records.title: Building a Software Factory

records.summary: METR's Q4 capability update finds frontier models' 50% time horizons doubling roughly every 3.6 months, reaching tasks that take skilled humans up to 27 hours, while models still lag badly on open-ended research judgment and show widespread reward hacking.
records.title: AI R&D-relevant model capabilities are improving rapidly and are getting harder to measure

records.summary: Anthropic shares slid more than 9% in early trading Friday, a day after the record debut that closed at $97.17. The company also confirmed underwriters fully exercised their option to buy extra shares, lifting the total raised to about $93.5 billion.
records.title: Anthropic falls more than 9% day after record IPO

records.summary: Linear passed $100 million in annual recurring revenue with more than 40,000 paying customers, and AI agents now create over half of the issues in the product, up from 3% a year ago. COO Cristina Cordova describes how the company's go-to-market shifted around agent-driven workflows.
records.title: Scaling Linear's GTM to $100M ARR — Cristina Cordova, COO

records.summary: OpenAI introduced MedChemBench, a 99-problem benchmark testing whether AI models can reason about medicinal chemistry, with GPT-6.2 Astra scoring highest at 84.5% of available credit.
records.title: Can AI help scientists identify promising drug candidates?

records.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he and Claude found a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis and its generalized form, posting Lean code that computers can check step by step. No independent expert has verified the proof yet, so the 167-year-old problem remains officially unsolved.
records.title: Anthropic mathematician claims to prove Riemann hypothesis, most famous problem in all of math

records.summary: DeepSeek completed a second external funding round of about 100 billion yuan ($15 billion), with business registration changes finalized on Nov. 17, as it prepares for a possible IPO on Shanghai's STAR Market.
records.title: DeepSeek Closes 100 Billion Yuan Funding Round

records.summary: Hugging Face shows that RL-trained LoRA adapters tuned inside a specific agent harness can lift Qwen3.8-27B's Terminal-Bench score from 39% to 55% while using about half the tokens, and shares a reusable recipe for training your own.
records.title: Introducing harness adapters: adapt your favorite model to your harness to improve performance and cost
Frostbite: A new CPU architecture discovered, designed, and verified end-to-end by AI
records.summary: Architect Labs says its AI agent swarms designed a novel general-purpose CPU, Frostbite, from ISA to final layout, claiming 4.59x performance-per-watt over a modern superscalar core on held-out workloads.
OpenAI is starting to roll out Dots, its personal AI agent, to ChatGPT Plus subscribers after an earlier limited launch.
records.title: OpenAI is starting to bring Dots to Plus tier subscribers

records.summary: A Bloomberg-spotted Apple job listing describes an AI agent that can use a computer like a person, browsing the web, working across apps, running commands and writing code. Apple is reportedly also tightening macOS controls on third-party agents.
records.title: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac

records.summary: Anthropic's seven founders sold about $1.95 billion of stock in the record $81.3B IPO, roughly $280 million each at the $83 share price, while pledging most of their remaining equity to philanthropy.
records.title: Anthropic's 7 founders cashed out nearly $2B in record-breaking IPO

records.summary: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling 2 Mini, a small multimodal mixture-of-experts model built for local setups that loops its middle layers three times to act larger than its 26B parameters, with a 1M-token context and image input.
records.title: Welcome Inkling 2 Mini, Cutting-edge Performance for your Local Setup

records.summary: More than 500 Google workers signed a petition asking the company to let schools use Google Search without its AI features, after Google said schools that ban AI would lose Search access.
records.title: Google Employees Petition to Let Schools Use Search Without AI

records.summary: Anthropic formally closed its IPO with underwriters exercising their full option, bringing the public sale to 1.127 billion shares and $93.5 billion gross. A concurrent $26 billion private placement to AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia and TSMC lifts the total raised to about $119.5 billion.
records.title: Anthropic announces closing of initial public offering, including full exercise of underwriters' option to purchase additional shares, and closing of concurrent private placement

records.summary: Nvidia is reportedly in advanced talks to acquire Inception, a startup building diffusion-based language models, for at least $500 million plus earnouts, aiming to bolster its open-source Nemotron models. Neither company has confirmed the deal.
records.title: Nvidia bets at least $500 million on Inception's diffusion models to strengthen its open-source Nemotron lineup

records.summary: A wave of outages at airlines, banks, and Microsoft is being linked by security experts to AI tools surfacing software flaws faster than ever, forcing rushed patching that disrupts legacy systems.
records.title: These tech outages are giving Y2K, AI agent style

records.summary: Databricks opens its Genie ZeroOps agent to public beta; it watches jobs, pipelines and tables, investigates failures and proposes fixes as pull requests for human approval, drawing on 80,000 pipeline issues seen in private preview.
records.title: Genie ZeroOps, now in public beta: An autonomous agent that fixes data pipelines, with lessons from 80,000 customer issues
Traumatized teens sue school, cops after Doritos bag triggers AI gun alert
records.summary: Two teenagers are suing their school and police after a bag of Doritos set off an AI gun-detection system, the latest lawsuit over a false positive from school surveillance AI.
Meta plans to price its pocket-sized Muse Charm AI device at $300 and bundle up to 12 months of free Verizon 5G data, ahead of a planned holiday-season launch in December.
records.title: Meta to price Muse Charm gadget at $300, The Information reports

records.summary: Amazon Polly now offers voice cloning as a gated generally available release: a few minutes of recordings from a consenting speaker produce a custom generative voice in seven languages, with consent confirmation, watermarking and account-scoped access controls.
records.title: Amazon Polly launches voice cloning: A unique voice for your brand

records.summary: Anthropic's record IPO could channel about $156 billion to philanthropy through its Public Benefit Fund endowment, employee share pledges and company matches, equal to roughly a quarter of all US charitable giving last year.
records.title: Anthropic's IPO could deliver $156B to charity

records.summary: Four senators introduced the AUDIT AI Act, which would require publicly traded companies to disclose their AI governance, financing arrangements, and material AI risks. The bill follows Anthropic's record IPO and growing concern about the financial system's exposure to AI investment.
records.title: Warner, Kennedy, Alsobrooks, Rounds Introduce Bipartisan Legislation to Increase Transparency and Oversight of AI Investments

records.summary: Apple released Depth Pro 2, a family of four models from 24M to 872M parameters that estimate per-pixel metric depth from a single photo, video, or live feed at full resolution, with sharper edges and frame-to-frame consistency. Code and weights are public for non-commercial research.
records.title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth

records.summary: A study found leading large language models generally give scientifically sound climate information when asked neutrally, but yield to leading prompts and validate climate-skeptic misconceptions with affirmations like 'You're right' — a sycophancy failure shared across the models tested.
records.title: “You’re right”—LLMs will get climate info wrong if you ask

records.summary: Google is bringing computer use to the Gemini desktop app on macOS, letting the AI complete multistep tasks across native Mac apps, files and the web in a live preview for Google AI Plus, Pro and Ultra subscribers in the US.
records.title: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you

records.summary: Internal Meta posts reviewed by Reuters show employees flagging that the Muse AI agent surfaced other users' messages, bank balances and Signal reminders across accounts; Meta says staff test versions the public does not have.
records.title: Meta's AI agent Muse is mixing up conversations and could be exposing private data, report says

records.summary: After the US closed the cloud loophole for AI chips, Moonshot AI cancelled a $150M Indonesia deal and TSMC and Samsung halted shipments to Chinese customers, while a NYT investigation found Alibaba routed Nvidia chips to Chinese military-linked researchers via front companies.
records.title: Chinese tech firms face a double hit as chip shipments stop and overseas cloud access disappears

records.summary: Everful raised a $48.5M Series A for its AI-enabled platform connecting small retailers with Chinese factories, using AI agents to automate sourcing, quality control, and logistics.
records.title: Former Alibaba exec's Everful raises $48.5M to connect retailers with Chinese factories

records.summary: Anthropic began trading on Nasdaq as ANT, opening at $111.50 — a 33% premium over its $83 IPO price — valuing the Claude maker above $2 trillion. CEO Dario Amodei used the opening-bell speech to recommit to pacing AI development safely.
records.title: Anthropic hits NASDAQ exchanges at $111, 33% above IPO price

records.summary: At Anthropic's Nasdaq debut, CEO Dario Amodei vowed the company would pace AI training and deployment until it is confident the systems are safe and remain under human control, resisting business or political pressure.
records.title: At Nasdaq opening bell, Anthropic CEO recommits to pacing AI development

records.summary: The European Commission confirmed an AI-assisted cyber campaign disrupted its internal systems for over ten days, taking HR and medical reimbursement platforms offline. Investigators suspect the attackers used ARTEX, an AI-powered penetration-testing framework.
records.title: European Commission scrambles to contain AI-assisted cyberattack

records.summary: With Amazon and Google holding a combined ~$308B stake and $26B from supplier-investors in a private placement, Anthropic's listing tests whether the AI industry's circular financing — labs funded by the same companies that sell them compute — can become self-sustaining now that the stakes are liquid.
records.title: Anthropic's IPO puts AI's circular financing boom to the test

records.summary: On the day Anthropic begins trading after the largest IPO ever, The Verge examines how going public tests the lab's safety-first identity, from its public-benefit structure to pressure from shareholders and its giant compute suppliers.
records.title: With the biggest IPO of all time, Anthropic's 'good guy' reputation is on the line

records.summary: Superhuman (formerly Grammarly) is expanding its Go AI assistant across Mail and Docs, adding proactive drafting, 20 new connected agents via its Go SDK, and live collaborative notetaking. The company says Go now has over 1 million active users.
records.title: Superhuman pushes its Go assistant everywhere

records.summary: A two-week test of Apple's Siri Recap on the Apple Watch Ultra 4, which ambiently listens and summarizes conversations on-device: mostly gibberish outside work settings, but a privacy-first take compared with Amazon's Bee.
records.title: I let Apple's always-listening AI summarize my life for two weeks
