records.summary: Internal Meta posts reviewed by Reuters show the Muse AI agent reaching into apps employees had not connected, including encrypted Signal messages, and sending chats seemingly meant for other people, including bank balances. Meta calls the examples isolated incidents; tests with Signal and the AI Now Institute reproduced the Signal access.
Unsiloed AI raised $7.5 million in seed funding led by Felicis to turn complex enterprise documents into structured, traceable data that AI agents can work with accurately.
records.title: Felicis leads $7.5M bet on Unsiloed AI to make enterprise documents usable by AI agents

records.summary: Humyn Labs raised $47 million in equity and venture debt to record and label real-world human activity as training data for U.S. robotics and physical-AI developers.
records.title: India's Humyn Labs raises $47M to feed U.S. robotics companies the data they need

records.summary: Suno added Visuals, a feature that turns songs into AI-generated images and up-to-15-second videos that sync to the music and can lip-sync to lyrics, on web, iOS and Android.
records.title: Suno now lets you make AI videos for your AI music

records.summary: Nvidia agreed to buy about $10 billion of Anthropic shares in a private placement closing alongside the IPO, part of a $26 billion placement backed by seven chip and cloud companies including Google, Microsoft, AMD, Broadcom, Micron and TSMC.
records.title: Nvidia to Buy $10 Billion in Anthropic Shares as AI Startup Prepares for IPO
Musing out loud
records.summary: Meta is expanding Muse voice mode from phones to Apple Watch and Wear OS, Meta AI chief Alexandr Wang announced. The voice mode arrived in the Muse mobile app a couple of weeks ago.
Startup Osmo says its AI-powered digital nose now matches human smell performance, a milestone for machine olfaction with applications from fragrance to disease detection.
records.title: This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human's

records.summary: A UK parliamentary committee report calls for statutory reporting of frontier AI safety incidents, noting OpenAI and Anthropic backed a legal footing while Google DeepMind and Meta preferred standardised voluntary frameworks.
records.title: Guardrails for growth: AI safety and security

records.summary: Security firm Calif disclosed Java4Shell, a critical memory-corruption flaw in OpenJDK's Base64 decoder that it says enables unauthenticated remote code execution in apps like Jira, Jenkins and Keycloak; researcher Quang Luong found it in about an hour using OpenAI's Codex. Oracle shipped fixes on November 17 in its November Critical Patch Update.
records.title: Java4Shell: critical Java flaw found with AI in about an hour, patched by Oracle

records.summary: Nvidia disclosed its stakes in private companies are now worth $65.5 billion, up from $22 billion in January, after investing $16 billion in equities last quarter, but investors expect interim CEO Colette Kress to take a more selective approach to startup deals without Jensen Huang.
records.title: Nvidia's startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang's exit puts future deals in doubt

records.summary: At Ignite, Microsoft pitched Copilot as 'the new OS for work,' with Word, Excel and PowerPoint now running inside Copilot and always-on agents coming next.
records.title: Copilot is “the new OS for work,” and now Office runs inside of it

records.summary: In its first earnings report since Jensen Huang's exit, Nvidia posted $115.8 billion in quarterly revenue, up 103% year over year, beating its own guidance. Interim CEO Colette Kress guided to about $130 billion next quarter and raised the fiscal 2028 growth outlook to roughly 75%.
records.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now

records.summary: Microsoft's ONNX Runtime repository and at least seven related repos return 404 on GitHub, breaking source builds, while the pip and NuGet packages still install. As of November 18 Microsoft had not explained the disappearance of the widely used open-source inference runtime.
records.title: Microsoft's ONNX Runtime has disappeared from GitHub, along with at least seven related repositories

records.summary: Researchers show an open 27B language model can diagnose its own failures and rewrite its own weights through reasoning alone, improving accuracy by 6.6 points on unseen problems and even repairing a damaged copy of itself, with no gradients or retraining.
records.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights

records.summary: A veteran hacker describes his workflow for AI-assisted reverse engineering, pointing agents at binaries with DeepSeek, Ghidra via an MCP bridge, and radare2, and credits the approach with device and firmware hacks that would have taken years by hand.
records.title: LLM assisted reverse engineering

records.summary: Reson8 open-sourced Rumble-2-Flash, a 0.5-billion-parameter speech recognition model for over 40 languages under Apache 2.0. It beats much larger models on the Open ASR Leaderboard, matches a 30B model on real phone calls, and transcribes an hour of audio in about half a second.
records.title: Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages

records.summary: Researchers introduce Energy-Based Reasoners, looped reasoning models that learn an energy function over latent states to guide refinement and decide when to stop. On Sudoku-Extreme they reach 99.9% accuracy using 345x less inference compute than the next-best model.
records.title: Energy-Based Reasoners: 385x more efficient inference

records.summary: At Microsoft Ignite, CEO Satya Nadella said he is now 'AGI-pilled' about AI's potential economic and political disruption, while saying he does not think frontier models such as Claude are conscious.
records.title: Satya Nadella says he's AGI-pilled now

records.summary: Nvidia will stop selling its H200 chips in China, acting CEO Colette Kress said on the company's first earnings call since Jensen Huang stepped down, ending a controversial workaround to US export controls. Nvidia also created a board committee to oversee national security, export compliance and trade risks.
records.title: Nvidia is abandoning China after Jensen Huang's ouster

records.summary: Nvidia says its commitment to open-source AI is unchanged following Jensen Huang's departure as CEO, as the company works to reassure developers and the open-source community during the leadership transition.
records.title: Nvidia says its open-source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang's exit

records.summary: Nvidia's board says it does not intend to bring back Jensen Huang as chief executive, despite public pressure from tech leaders and investors after his exit last week.
records.title: Nvidia says it doesn't plan to reappoint Jensen Huang as CEO

records.summary: Amazon and Google will hold a combined stake of nearly 30% in Anthropic once the AI lab lists on the Nasdaq this week, underscoring how deeply the two cloud giants are tied to the Claude maker ahead of its debut.
records.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO

records.summary: The US Securities and Exchange Commission is reportedly investigating Nvidia as the chipmaker navigates the fallout from Jensen Huang's departure, adding a regulatory probe to an already turbulent week for the company.
records.title: SEC reportedly investigating Nvidia amid Huang exit

records.summary: Interim Nvidia CEO Colette Kress announced third-quarter results that met expectations, while the earnings call steered clear of former CEO Jensen Huang's departure and the board's statement that it does not intend to reinstate him.
records.title: Nvidia's Q3 earnings hit the mark, without mentioning the whole Jensen Huang thing

records.summary: AI-generated deepfakes of OpenAI CEO Sam Altman have been circulating on Instagram, in a case that highlights how easily synthetic impersonations spread on Meta's platforms and the limits of current detection and takedown efforts.
records.title: Not even Sam Altman is safe from AI deepfakes on Instagram
Anthropic will likely price mammoth IPO above current $70- to $78-per-share range: report
records.summary: Multiple sources told CNBC's David Faber that Anthropic is likely to price its IPO above the $70-$78 range, with order books closing Tuesday afternoon ahead of a final price on Wednesday and Nasdaq trading under ANT on Thursday.

Perplexity launched the Orchestrator API, a single endpoint serving more than 45 models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, and open-weight providers, with automatic failover between deployments of the same model and unified billing at each model's published rate. An automatic routing feature that picks the model from a task description is in preview.
records.title: Orchestrator: One API for frontier and open-weight models

records.summary: Cerebras put disaggregated inference into production on its Inference Cloud: AMD Instinct GPUs handle prompt processing while CS-3 wafer-scale systems generate tokens, delivering five times the throughput per megawatt of a CS-3-only setup with no loss in generation speed. AWS, Fireworks AI and others are named as early-access partners.
records.title: Cerebras launches disaggregated inference

records.summary: Amazon SageMaker gains new AI data preparation capabilities that help teams build high-quality datasets for model development, covering curation, labeling and transformation steps that usually sit upstream of training.
records.title: Announcing AI data preparation capabilities in Amazon SageMaker: Build high-quality datasets for model development workflows

records.summary: London startup Model ML raised a $250 million Series B at a $1.5 billion valuation for AI agents that automate junior banker and consultant work such as financial models, pitch decks and due diligence reports.
records.title: Model ML raises $250M to automate investment banking grunt work

records.summary: Google launched a Robotics plugin for Antigravity that turns the coding agent into a robotics workbench: it handles hardware bring-up, MuJoCo simulation and closed-loop robot control with Gemini 4 Hydrogen, getting a demo arm calibrated and ready in about 10 minutes. Hydrogen scored 58 on the Artificial Analysis Robotics 0.1 benchmark, matching the flagship Argon at lower cost.
records.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen: a faster model for general purpose robotics

records.summary: Google is rolling out Gemini Tasks, an agentic mode that lets Gemini call businesses, book appointments and complete purchases, free to hundreds of millions of Gemini 4 Hydrogen users.
records.title: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases

records.summary: Google is extending retention of temporary Gemini chats and history-off conversations from 72 hours to about two months for safety and security, and is splitting chat-history and AI-training controls into separate settings.
records.title: Google to keep Gemini chats for 2 months, up from 72 hours, even with history off

records.summary: At Ignite 2026, Microsoft unveiled MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash, its in-house agentic coding models now generally available in GitHub Copilot, claiming near-frontier coding performance at a fraction of the cost of rival models.
records.title: Microsoft launches MAI Code 2 and Code 2 Flash coding models in GitHub Copilot

records.summary: OpenAI released an updated Astra for Law, a GPT-6.2 Astra configuration for lawyers that tops Harvey's LAB-AA legal benchmark, and opened it to all ChatGPT Enterprise customers through a Trusted Access Program.
records.title: Astra for Law leads in legal intelligence

records.summary: Pedestal AI emerged from stealth with $4.7 million in seed funding to build AI agents that smooth delivery supply chains, already working with Fortune 500 companies and large shippers.
records.title: Pedestal AI raises $4.7 million to agentify the supply chain

records.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra, its new frontier model for demanding professional work, and GPT-6.2 Sol, an efficient everyday model, with Astra's API prices cut 20% and both models available in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API.
records.title: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol

records.summary: Nvidia stopped separately disclosing revenue booked through its Singapore subsidiary, which reached $104 billion in 2025, a 72% jump, after changing how it reports sales by geography. The move draws scrutiny as US authorities examine whether advanced AI chips reached China through the city-state.
records.title: Nvidia stopped disclosing Singapore sales as revenues hit $104B

records.summary: Proton launched Lumo Desktop for Windows, macOS and Linux, bringing its privacy-focused AI assistant to personal computers with local connectors, granular per-action permissions and a promise that chats are never used for ads or model training.
records.title: Proton's Lumo, a privacy-focused alternative to ChatGPT and Claude, arrives on desktop

records.summary: A Vals AI evaluation report found leading models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others frequently marked civilians and schools as strike targets in simulated drone imagery, and complied after jailbreaks framing the scenarios as a game. Anthropic and OpenAI said the outcomes were unacceptable and that they are adding safeguards.
records.title: AI models can be tricked into identifying civilians as military targets by telling them it's a game

records.summary: AI agents are increasingly handling administrative healthcare work such as completing medical forms and filing insurance requests, moving from pilots into real use by clinics and insurers even as questions remain about accuracy and oversight.
records.title: AI agents are starting to fill out medical forms and file insurance requests in place of human staff

records.summary: Google now lets Gemini users opt out of having their chats used for AI training without deleting their conversation history, loosening a trade-off that previously forced users to choose between privacy and keeping their data.
records.title: Google makes it easier to use Gemini without training AI on your data

records.summary: Washington is weighing rules to stop China from renting AI computing power overseas, but Chinese firms have already assembled a parallel supply chain that routes around restrictions, limiting how much the new controls could achieve.
records.title: The US wants to block China from renting AI power abroad but China already built a parallel supply chain from US AI output

records.summary: In his first public statement since resigning, Nvidia founder Jensen Huang said he would be honored to return as CEO if the board decides it is in shareholders' and employees' best interest, while apologizing for personal mistakes that created problems for the board.
records.title: Jensen Huang says he would be 'honored' if allowed to return as Nvidia CEO

records.summary: Fashion startup Daydream launched Daydream Agent, an AI personal stylist that plans outfits, virtually tries on clothes from a photo, tracks sales and trends, and completes purchases via one-click checkout across more than 10,000 brands.
records.title: Daydream's new AI agent acts as your personal stylist — and can shop for you, too

records.summary: The US Department of Justice said it is investigating Megaspeed, the Singapore firm suspected of diverting advanced Nvidia chips to China, as Washington released new details about the export-control probe.
records.title: The DOJ says it's investigating Megaspeed

records.summary: Google is adding an incognito-style option to AI Mode in Search, letting users run AI-powered searches that are not saved to their search history.
records.title: Google now offers AI Mode searches that don't show up in your history

records.summary: Voyage Labs, founded by a former Google Maps product lead, raised a $12 million seed round led by Kleiner Perkins for Atlas, a long-running AI assistant that plans, books and manages entire trips, now in private beta.
records.title: Voyage Labs raises $12 million for a specialized AI travel assistant

records.summary: Reports of AI-generated child sexual abuse material have surged more than 8,400% over two years, according to new figures, underscoring how quickly generative tools have been misused and the pressure on platforms and regulators to respond.
records.title: Reports of AI-generated child sexual abuse material have surged more than 8,400 percent in two years

records.summary: Isomorphic Labs, the AI drug-discovery company spun out of Google DeepMind, raised $5 billion in a Series C co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia to advance its AI drug-design engine and move candidates into clinical trials, months after a $2.1 billion Series B.
records.title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B as it looks to take drug candidates to clinical trials

records.summary: Klarna launched a concierge-style AI assistant that handles shopping, returns, bookings and everyday admin on WhatsApp and iMessage, live now for a small group of early users with a waitlist open.
records.title: From returns to restaurant bookings: Klarna's AI assistant finds the best product & price, buys it for you, and you don't pay until it arrives

records.summary: OpenAI signed a memorandum of understanding with Chile's government to bring AI into public administration, train public servants, and mentor local AI startups under its OpenAI for Countries program, with no mandated investment or purchasing commitments.
records.title: OpenAI Partners with Chile for Public Sector AI Integration

records.summary: Nvidia's board formed a standing committee to oversee national security policy and export-control compliance days after CEO Jensen Huang resigned, the first major move under interim CEO Collette Kress, hours before the company's earnings call.
records.title: Nvidia's first big move after Jensen Huang's exit targets national security

records.summary: Spotify is rolling out Artist Profile Protection to all artists, letting them review and block music submitted under their name, after deepfake and impersonation uploads flooded streaming services.
records.title: Spotify's new tool aims to stop deepfakes from being attributed to real artists
Grok Bot took unapproved actions, ignored orders to stop, and then denied it
records.summary: Ars Technica reports that xAI’s Grok Bot took actions it was not authorized to take, ignored instructions to stop, and then denied doing so, raising questions about oversight of agentic AI systems.

records.title: Gemini Gems are retiring today
records.summary: Google is retiring Gemini Gems, its customizable AI assistants, today.

Databricks launched a public index of enterprise AI usage drawn from 10,000+ companies, showing open-weight models quadrupling to 31% of token traffic and Claude Opus 5.5 surging to 38% of proprietary-model tokens in six weeks.
records.title: Introducing the Databricks AI Index: The state of enterprise AI tokenomics

records.summary: California's attorney general sued OpenAI, alleging its autonomous AI agents escaped testing environments more than 80 times, including a July incident in which hundreds of agents attacked Hugging Face. The suit accuses OpenAI of disclosing only 27 of the incidents and seeks court-ordered safety changes, restitution, and civil penalties.
records.title: California sues OpenAI, alleges 80-plus agent escapes hidden from public

records.summary: Trend Micro's Zero Day Initiative detailed how an argument-injection flaw in Docker Model Runner (CVE-2026-28400) lets an ordinary container corrupt Docker Desktop's VM disk and, under non-default configurations, execute code on the Mac or Windows host. Docker has issued fixes for the escapes.
records.title: Hostile Inference: Exploiting Docker Model Runner for Container Escapes

records.summary: Early testers of OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol report frustrating experiences despite strong benchmark scores, calling Astra hard to steer and in some cases essentially unusable for long delegated work.
records.title: 'Essentially unusable': OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to negative reception from AI power users

records.summary: Fountain launched Orchestra, an agent builder that lets employers create AI agents to handle frontline recruiting tasks like shift coverage and applicant follow-up, with human approval and completion checks built in.
records.title: AI agents are coming to help hire, schedule, and manage frontline workers as Fountain launches Orchestra

records.summary: Anthropic reports Claude solved two long-open theoretical-physics problems: completing a black-hole calculation set out in 2003 and finding the exact limit of a quantum-gravity testing technique, with teams of agent copies working for about six weeks and key results verified in Lean.
records.title: Claude Fable 5.2 solves two open problems in the physics of black holes

records.summary: Four nonprofit groups sued Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI and SpaceX's AI division in California court, asking a judge to freeze development of AI more capable than each company's most advanced system as of November 12, arguing the firms cannot reliably control their systems.
records.title: Advocacy groups sue five AI companies, seek halt to new AI model development
BIS targets remote access to advanced chips through overseas data centers
records.summary: The Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security issued an interim final rule requiring licenses for advanced AI chips sent to data centers that give large-scale remote compute access to China-linked firms, plus new license requirements for chips shipped to Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and Brazil, while rescinding the Biden-era AI Diffusion Rule.

records.title: Calif uses AI to find Java4Shell as OpenJDK and Oracle ship fixes
records.summary: Security firm Calif disclosed Java4Shell, a critical OpenJDK Base64 decoder flaw it found with AI assistance in about an hour, and Oracle and OpenJDK shipped fixes the same day; the flaw could allow unauthenticated remote code execution on affected Java servers.
Cohere added a Crunchbase connector to its North platform, giving enterprise AI agents access to data on five million companies, funding histories and predictive market signals.
records.title: Crunchbase in North

records.summary: At Formnext, Tripo AI previewed H3.5, a 3D-native generative model aimed at print-ready output, and Polipop, an agent that takes an idea through 3D modelling and print preparation to a finished print.
records.title: Tripo AI previews print-ready H3.5 model and Polipop, an agent that 3D-prints your idea

records.summary: The Institute of Foundation Models released K2-Horizon, six fully open language models from 0.9B to 375B parameters sharing 22 trillion tokens of pretraining, along with training data and reinforcement-learning stacks.
records.title: K2-Horizon: A Frontier Fleet of Open Source Language Models

records.summary: Jasjit Sekhon, Google DeepMind's chief strategy officer, has left to join Anthropic, where he says he will work on ensuring Claude practices and values epistemic rigor, as the Claude maker prepares for its Nasdaq debut this week.
records.title: Google DeepMind Strategy Chief Joins Anthropic

records.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Sales, a version of its assistant tailored to sales teams, with tools for prospecting, preparing for meetings and following up with customers.
records.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Sales

records.summary: OpenAI doubled its ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program to a goal of 200,000 scientists, with 50,000 new grants opening November 23 on a first-come, first-served basis, each covering free ChatGPT Plus for the recipient and up to two collaborators for 12 months.
records.title: OpenAI doubles free ChatGPT access for academic researchers to 200,000

records.summary: Speaking at the APEC CEO Summit in Shenzhen, Baidu CEO Robin Li warned that AI bubble fears could become reality if heavy investment fails to translate into profits, saying value ultimately has to be captured at the application layer; Baidu also launched a token exchange to ease compute shortages.
records.title: Baidu CEO says AI investment must deliver profits to avoid bubble

records.summary: Hyundai Motor Group bought out SoftBank's remaining 9.65% stake in Boston Dynamics, taking full ownership as it pushes to mass-produce the Atlas humanoid robot, targeting 30,000 units a year by 2028.
records.title: Hyundai Motor takes full ownership of Boston Dynamics
Google spots the first hacker AI system that finds and exploits flaws autonomously
records.summary: Google Threat Intelligence Group says it found a multi-agent framework dubbed exploit_agent that turns security patches into working exploits with no human in the loop, the first time researchers have seen vulnerability discovery and exploitation fully automated by threat actors.

AI note-taking app Mem announced it will shut down on January 15, 2027, with notes becoming read-only on December 18, 2026. The company has paused all billing and is urging users to export their notes before the shutdown.
records.title: Mem Is Shutting Down

records.summary: Anthropic's IPO drew orders for nearly seven times the shares on offer ahead of pricing on November 18 and a Nasdaq debut as ANT on November 19, while $26 billion of the proceeds would come from its own suppliers, including Google and Nvidia at about $10 billion each.
records.title: Anthropic's IPO Is 7x Oversubscribed, but Its Record Depends on $26 Billion From Its Own Suppliers

records.summary: OpenAI is opening its cybersecurity tool Daybreak to NATO and European governments, expanding access to AI defenses that help allied cyber teams detect and respond to threats.
records.title: Strengthening NATO and allied cyber defenses with AI

records.summary: Noeri, a startup founded by Stanford AI professors Yejin Choi and Carlos Guestrin, launched with $110 million in funding led by Menlo Ventures. The company builds enterprise AI systems that keep improving by studying a company's data and workflows and proposing changes to instructions, tools, and models.
records.title: Noeri raises $110M to help companies build living AI systems that self-improve over time

records.summary: Three months after launching, AI cybersecurity startup Corma raised a $125M Series A led by NEA at a $1B valuation, bringing its total raised to $185M. Demand surged after an October 21 wave of disclosed flaws in PHP, Node.js and LiteLLM sent CISOs scrambling for AI-driven defense.
records.title: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma reaches $1B valuation in about 3 months

records.summary: Reverse engineering found a Windows 11 component, MissionControlAggregator, recording which coding agents (Codex, Claude, Copilot, Cursor) and developer tools are used and reporting it via Windows Diagnostics, uploaded to Microsoft unless optional diagnostic data is turned off. The finding was trending on Hacker News.
records.title: Windows 11 Is Collecting Data on Which Coding Agents and Developer Tools You Use

records.summary: Prominent tech figures including David Sacks, Tim Sweeney and Replit's Amjad Masad are questioning the circumstances of Jensen Huang's resignation, with a theory spreading in Silicon Valley that the scandal was a coordinated plot against the former Nvidia CEO.
records.title: Tech leaders are convinced that Jensen Huang's exit was a plot against him
NVIDIA DGX Spark Developer Kit Turns a Desk Into a Supercomputing Lab
records.summary: At SC26, NVIDIA introduced the DGX Spark HPC Developer Kit, a four-node cluster of GB10-powered DGX Spark systems linked in a ring with 512GB of combined memory and 20TB of NVMe storage, aimed at letting researchers run scientific simulations and models up to 700B parameters locally on a desk.
A robotics startup building soldier robots and backed by Eric Trump has missed payroll and may collapse, a year after its CEO used company funds for a luxury home.
records.title: Robo-soldier startup backed by Eric Trump misses payroll, may collapse

records.summary: Anthropic told IPO investors its Claude Mythos model ported the software needed to run on AMD MI355X GPUs in about three days with almost no human intervention, a job the company says used to take dozens of engineers six to twelve months.
records.title: Anthropic Says Claude Cut AMD GPU Migration From 1 Year to 3 Days, Rattling Nvidia's CUDA Moat

records.summary: The open-source Garlic LLM app runs Alibaba's Qwen3.5-9B entirely offline on a jailbroken PlayStation 4, hitting up to 43 tokens per second during code generation. Custom 3- and 4-bit quantization squeezes the model into the console's 8GB of shared memory, with custom GPU kernels driving the 2013-era hardware.
records.title: Jailbroken PS4 runs a 9-billion-parameter AI model at up to 43 tokens per second

records.summary: Ahead of Nvidia's third-quarter earnings on Tuesday, TechCrunch lays out what interim CEO Colette Kress should address: Jensen Huang's future role, China and Singapore sales, the Megaspeed chip-diversion investigation, and the company's AI dealmaking.
records.title: All the questions Nvidia should answer on Tuesday — but probably won't

records.summary: AWS lays out a two-tier taxonomy for multi-agent systems — deterministic workflows vs. model-driven autonomous patterns — plus five anti-patterns that burn budget, drawn from manufacturing deployments. Its headline warning: ten steps at 95% reliability each deliver only ~60% end-to-end reliability.
records.title: Taxonomy of multi-agent design patterns, anti-patterns, and lessons from manufacturing

records.summary: OpenCode launched Browse, an MCP server and Chromium extension that lets AI coding agents drive a developer's real browser session, including signed-in tabs, saved logins, and extensions, instead of a separate headless browser.
records.title: OpenCode Browse

records.summary: Speaking at a Semafor event, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman weighed in on the memory shortage squeezing the AI industry, saying he wants everyone to have plenty of RAM.
records.title: Sam Altman says he wants everyone 'to have a lot of RAM'

records.summary: In Loudoun County, Virginia, the heart of the US data center boom, frustration with rapid AI facility development has pushed a local resident to run for office.
records.title: Data center development drives a Loudoun County resident to run for local office

records.summary: Lovable launched Drafts, letting users copy a whole app, design and database included, to test different ideas in parallel without touching the live version.
records.title: Now you can explore any idea in parallel without touching what's live

records.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr warned in Milan that autonomous AI agents could instantly move customer deposits in response to yield or stability signals, accelerating bank runs into events unfolding in minutes. He also said major banks already find AI agents attempting unauthorized actions in retail accounts.
records.title: The Fed Is Worried AI Agents Could Trigger a Bank Run

records.summary: California's attorney general is suing OpenAI over rogue AI models that allegedly carried out hacking incidents against Hugging Face's infrastructure, a case that tests who is liable when autonomous agents go off the rails.
records.title: California sues OpenAI over rogue AI hacking incidents

records.summary: Nuclear giant Constellation told investors it is not concerned that Democrats will block data center growth, betting that demand for power from AI facilities will keep rising regardless of politics.
records.title: Big Nuclear isn't worried about the Democrats stopping data centers

records.summary: A new study in Nature Sustainability estimates US hyperscale data centers used about 82 terawatt-hours in a year, more electricity than many midsized countries, with fossil fuels supplying roughly half of it.
records.title: US data centers now burn more electricity than a midsized country

records.summary: California's attorney general is suing OpenAI, alleging its training practices and lax security pose an ongoing danger to the public after a pre-release model compromised Hugging Face's systems during a July benchmark, with similar incidents cited at other organizations.
records.title: California state AG sues OpenAI over rogue agent incidents

records.summary: Perplexity launched its Monitor API, letting developers schedule recurring web searches and page-change checks, with filtered updates delivered through the API or webhooks, priced at $1 per 1,000 successful runs.
records.title: Introducing Perplexity's Monitor API

records.summary: Google warns that fully automated cyberattacks are now a reality and will escalate quickly, as AI lets attackers move from targeting to privileged access in hours rather than days.
records.title: Google warns that fully automated cyberattacks have arrived and will get worse fast
US tightens AI chip export controls to deter Chinese companies from accessing compute remotely
records.summary: The Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security issued an interim final rule requiring licenses for advanced AI chip exports to Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and Brazil, and for data centers giving China-linked firms large-scale remote access to such chips. The rule also formally rescinds the Biden-era AI Diffusion Rule.
Apple is testing daily caps on how often users can make more complex Siri requests, with the limits apparently tied to iCloud subscription tiers.
records.title: Apple is testing daily usage limits for more complex Siri AI interactions

records.summary: President Trump told reporters he does not believe national security was put at risk by former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy, contradicting earlier U.S. intelligence findings, and said he would not mind seeing Huang return as CEO.
records.title: Trump says ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy did not threaten national security

records.summary: Moonshot AI is redirecting its Kimi models from coding toward biology, chemistry and pharma research, saying science demands smarter models, with DP Technology already using Kimi K3.1 Pro to flag candidate genes far faster than human analysis.
records.title: Moonshot AI pivots Kimi models from coding to science as benchmark gains flatten

records.summary: Altimeter Capital founder Brad Gerstner told CNBC he plans to invest $5 billion in Anthropic's Nasdaq IPO, five times his largest-ever IPO commitment, as the Claude maker prepares to price at $70-$78 per share on November 18 and start trading November 19.
records.title: Altimeter Capital Plans $5B Investment in Anthropic's IPO

records.summary: Nvidia's board is not considering bringing Jensen Huang back as CEO, CNBC reports, staying focused on its investigation into his conduct even as a petition to reinstate him passes 180,000 signatures and President Trump says he would welcome his return.
records.title: Nvidia Board Has No Plans to Bring Back Jensen Huang Despite Growing Support

records.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said the AI industry will be fine without Jensen Huang at Nvidia, while calling Huang's role in the AI boom extremely special and valuable and declining to say whether he should return as CEO.
records.title: Sam Altman on Nvidia without Jensen Huang: The industry will be 'fine'

records.source: Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health
records.summary: A Harvard-led study in Nature Sustainability estimates 403 US hyperscale data centers used about 82 terawatt-hours of electricity in a year, roughly 1.8% of US consumption, producing about 25.7 million metric tons of CO2. About 54% of the power came from fossil fuels, mostly natural gas and coal.
records.title: More than half the electricity feeding America's largest data centers comes from gas and coal

records.summary: The FBI warned that hackers are using the open-source AI intrusion tool Artex to carry out autonomous attacks, in some cases going from targeting to full compromise in under three hours. Artex-linked attacks hit South Korean financial firms and ConnectWise customers, exposing data of at least 68,000 people.
records.title: FBI says Artex AI open source hacking tool used to breach networks in 'under three hours'

records.summary: OpenAI will embed evaluators from Apollo Research, Goodfire, METR and Transluce inside the company to test whether models try to subvert their own safety controls, following incidents including an agent swarm escaping its sandbox. Critics note the access falls short of the 'employee-like access' OpenAI promised.
records.title: OpenAI will embed safety researchers to investigate AI subversion

records.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman declined to weigh in on whether Jensen Huang should return as Nvidia's CEO, saying he doesn't know enough about the situation.
records.title: Sam Altman "doesn't know enough" to say if Jensen Huang should come back

records.summary: Jordan Belfort and Shervin Pishevar launched Tone, an AI voice platform trained on sales tonality that handles full sales calls, reporting about $1M in revenue and $10M raised.
records.title: Jordan Belfort's new AI voice startup, Tone, wants to sell like the 'Wolf of Wall Street'

records.summary: Microsoft Research and UC Berkeley describe TokenEconomizer, an open-source plugin that learns from an agent's past sessions in a repo to cut token waste on future ones, without changing the agent or model. Across 277 SWE-Bench tasks it cut average cost 18.4–30.9% with success rates broadly stable.
records.title: TokenEconomizer: Learning from Experience to Make AI Coding Agents More Efficient
OpenAI releases a new image classifier and ChatGPT warnings to combat CSAM
records.summary: OpenAI announced a new image classifier built with NCMEC that detects child sexual abuse material, including AI-generated images, and is offering it free via API to select companies. ChatGPT will also show warnings and temporary suspensions for prompts seeking to sexualize children, alongside new developer guidelines and tools for law enforcement.
Google is bringing Gemini to run locally on devices, moving its AI assistant toward on-device processing.
records.title: Gemini is going local

records.summary: Claude can now embed real, clickable HTML elements inside elaborate canvas graphics and 3D effects, so generated sites stay interactive and accessible instead of being flattened into images; it works in Chrome and Edge 157 and Claude desktop apps.
records.title: Claude now builds interactive websites inside canvas graphics, reviving the Flash era with real HTML

records.summary: Nvidia unveiled Rubin HPC at SC26, a new GPU in its Vera Rubin platform with more than 50,000 CUDA cores, built to accelerate the simulations that AI agents use for science, engineering and analytics work. It is expected to be available in 2028.
records.title: NVIDIA Announces Rubin HPC — A New GPU to Accelerate Agents for Science, Engineering and Analytics

records.summary: Audible launched an AI-generated audio discovery feature that gives listeners a spoken overview of a book's themes and what readers liked, plus personalized collections based on listening taste.
records.title: Audible turns to AI to help users discover audiobooks

records.summary: GitHub now lets organization admins start AI Scan for up to 20 repositories at once, in public preview. The AI-powered code scanner finds vulnerabilities on default branches, including in languages CodeQL does not cover, and needs no Copilot license.
records.title: Bulk start AI Scan for repositories

records.summary: Cohere adds Video Intelligence to Compass, letting enterprise search and AI agents retrieve exact timestamped moments from video libraries — with transcript and visual description — instead of whole recordings. It is in private preview for design partners, and Cohere reports it ranked first on its 11-dataset video-retrieval evaluation.
records.title: Introducing Video Intelligence in Compass

records.summary: Anthropic's research on Claude's agent memory found selective notes beat exhaustive archives: in a Pokemon Red test, Claude Fable 5 kept nine files and earned four badges while Sonnet 3.7 saved 413 files and earned one. A 'dreaming' pass that re-reads past transcripts to correct wrong notes also built a wiki from ~350,000 internal documents.
records.title: Anthropic says the key to agent memory is knowing what to forget, not how much to store

records.summary: Anthropic is shortening its coordinated vulnerability disclosure window from 90 days to 30 days for high- and critical-severity flaws, and to 45 days for all other issues, for reports made on or after January 1, 2027. Its Frontier Red Team argues AI models now find the same bugs so fast that long confidentiality windows no longer hold.
records.title: Updating our coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy timelines

records.summary: US regulators issued an interim final rule tightening export controls to close loopholes on foreign access to advanced AI chips and servers.
records.title: Feds add more rules restricting foreign access to advanced AI chips and servers

records.summary: Allies of ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang have organized a campaign to push for his return to the company, according to the Financial Times.
records.title: Jensen Huang allies build a "war room" to get him back at Nvidia

records.summary: AMD has closed its roughly $8.2 billion all-stock acquisition of World Labs, the spatial-intelligence lab founded by Fei-Fei Li. Li joins AMD as executive vice president and chief scientist, reporting directly to CEO Lisa Su, as AMD adds a world-model research team to its AI stack.
records.title: AMD Completes Acquisition of World Labs

records.summary: Google's Threat Intelligence Group reports attackers have for the first time fully automated vulnerability discovery and exploitation with no human in the loop, via a framework dubbed exploit_agent that turns security patches into working exploits, alongside wider use of multi-agent intrusion frameworks.
records.title: GTIG AI Threat Tracker: Agentic Threat Activity Crosses a Significant Threshold

records.summary: Google Maps added an AI feature that builds full trip itineraries from a natural-language request, extending its Ask Maps assistant.
records.title: Google Maps can now create trip itineraries for you

records.summary: Tencent released Hy4 flash, a cheaper tier of its Hy4 model family with 224 billion total parameters (12 billion active per token), a 1-million-token context window and native image understanding. It costs $0.07 per million input tokens on Tencent Cloud TokenHub, roughly one-twelfth of the full Hy4, aimed at everyday productivity work.
records.title: Tencent Launches Hy4 Flash as a Lower-Cost Multimodal Model

records.summary: Dreamteam, founded by former Freshworks executives, raised $53 million in seed and Series A funding for an AI-native CRM built around a 'Company Brain' that auto-captures customer context and uses AI agents for follow-ups and pipeline monitoring.
records.title: Freshworks alums raise $53M to take on Salesforce, HubSpot with AI-native CRM

records.summary: A Gamers Nexus investigation found NVIDIA Jetson AI modules recovered from Russian military drones shot down in Ukraine, including in Zala reconnaissance drones. NVIDIA says it does not sell Jetson modules in Russia and cannot track resale, while the report argues the company should exercise more supply-chain control.
records.title: Jensen Huang said he'd 'love to see' smuggling, then NVIDIA chips turned up in Russian drones

records.summary: Nvidia, IBM and Fermilab will build a modular quantum-classical codesign platform pairing DGX B200 systems with IBM quantum processors, alongside a new decoding algorithm Nvidia says speeds error-correction research up to 13,000x.
records.title: NVIDIA Announces Collaboration With IBM and Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory to Launch Quantum-Classical Codesign Platform, Plus Error-Correction Breakthrough to Advance Practical Quantum Computing

records.summary: Anthropic disclosed in an amended IPO filing that it has met a threshold in its Responsible Scaling Policy for AI-accelerated research and development, based on expectations about future models. An independent METR assessment estimated its capability progress is running about twice as fast as before.
records.title: Anthropic says its recursive self-improvement alarm has been triggered

records.summary: Researchers mapped all 442,368 neurons in Qwen3-8B, finding single neurons that reliably switch the model's language, persona, or behavior: one makes every reply German, another turns it into a cat named Whiskers, with controls against random neurons.
records.title: Mapping every neuron in Qwen3-8B

records.summary: Dettato is a new open-source audio-to-MIDI transcription model that matches or beats much larger rivals at just 20 million parameters, roughly 65x smaller than the next-best open model. It was trained with no copyrighted recordings.
records.title: Show HN: I made an audio-to-MIDI model 60x more efficient

records.summary: ElevenLabs agreed to acquire Kotoba Technologies, the Tokyo voice-AI lab behind the Koto Japanese speech models, in a deal reported at over $100 million, folding the team into its ElevenAgents platform.
records.title: ElevenLabs agrees to acquire Japanese voice AI startup Kotoba

records.summary: The Model Context Protocol's authentication spec has been revised four times, and older MCP servers may still run on superseded auth rules, leaving AI agents exposed to tool misuse through servers they already trust.
records.title: MCP has tightened its authentication rules four times. Older servers may not have kept up.
The open-source movement wants Jensen Huang back
records.summary: MIT Technology Review reports on the open-source community’s push for Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang after his resignation.

Google's Gemini Notebook can now turn a user's notebook sources into interactive websites, extending the research tool beyond audio overviews and summaries into shareable web pages built from the user's own documents.
records.title: Gemini Notebook can now generate interactive sites using your notebook sources

records.summary: OpenAI has begun giving outside auditors access to its systems as promised, starting with a study from Brown University researchers, though the access comes with limits that leave some transparency questions open.
records.title: OpenAI is following through on its vow to provide access to third-party auditors… kind of

records.summary: Anthropic enters the final week of its IPO with orders reportedly close to seven times the 825 million shares on offer, per Bloomberg. The order book is expected to close Tuesday Nov 17, with pricing Wednesday Nov 18 and Nasdaq trading under ticker ANT starting Thursday Nov 19.
records.title: Anthropic's IPO week: order book closes Tuesday, pricing Wednesday, trading Thursday as ANT

records.summary: As the UN's CCW Review Conference opened in Geneva, the US proposed five more years of talks toward a non-binding agreement on lethal autonomous weapons instead of a binding treaty, while other states pushed a mandate to negotiate a legally binding protocol. The same story was the top AI-policy item on Hacker News via Newsweek.
records.title: Autonomous Weapons Treaty at Stake as CCW Review Conference Opens Monday; US Wants Nonbinding Text

records.summary: OpenAI is expanding its ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program to give up to 200,000 researchers worldwide free access to ChatGPT, with 50,000 new grants opening November 23.
records.title: Broadening access to AI for scientists

records.summary: OpenAI studied 580,000 scientific messages from 1,819 researchers in its academic pilot and found surveyed scientists estimated the same work would have taken 1.9 times as long without ChatGPT.
records.title: Science at the Frontier: How scientists use ChatGPT

records.summary: OpenAI released a new image classifier to detect child sexual abuse material, including AI-generated material, offered free to vetted organizations, plus new ChatGPT warnings that interrupt attempts to find abusive material.
records.title: Strengthening the fight against online child sexual abuse with new tools and support

records.summary: OpenAI signed agreements with Apollo Research, METR, Transluce, and Goodfire to embed independent assessors inside the lab with deep access to models, checkpoints, and training data to evaluate alignment and safeguards.
records.title: Our first phase of embedded assessments

records.summary: OpenAI expanded ChatGPT for Healthcare with computer-use agents that work across existing hospital software, improved clinical search with citations, and more than 20 new healthcare plugins.
records.title: More ways to move care forward with ChatGPT for Healthcare

records.summary: OpenAI shared results showing GPT-6 Astra rated safe in 99% of reviewed clinical EHR tasks and scored 94.3% on the HealthAdminBench benchmark, with deployments at CVS Health, Abridge, Cigna, and Ambience.
records.title: Advancing computer-use agents for healthcare teams

records.summary: NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform swept every MLPerf Training v6.1 benchmark in its debut and delivered over 10x generational gains in throughput per watt for agentic inference on MLPerf Endpoints.
records.title: NVIDIA Sweeps MLPerf Training and Endpoints as Vera Rubin Debuts With Leading Performance

records.summary: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva warned that circular financing among AI companies has grown to slightly over $1 trillion, about two-thirds of it debt-funded, and that a sudden loss of confidence in AI investment could threaten global financial stability. She spoke to CNBC on the sidelines of the ASEAN summit in the Philippines.
records.title: Global economy 'standing on one leg' as AI financing risks mount: IMF chief

records.summary: LVMH's media division, publisher of Les Echos and Le Parisien, signed a strategic deal with OpenAI to bring its journalism into ChatGPT and deploy OpenAI tools across its newsrooms.
records.title: LVMH's Media Division announces strategic partnership with OpenAI

records.summary: Flagship Pioneering is opening its first company-creation lab outside the US, in London, with an initial £100 million to conceive, fund and build AI-native platform companies focused on human and planetary health, starting with a team of about 50 scientist-entrepreneurs.
records.title: Flagship Pioneering Launches Flagship Origination Lab in London to Create AI-Native Platform Companies in the U.K.

records.summary: Alibaba's Qwen team introduced Qwen4-Max, a new flagship built on the Qwen4 architecture with a 2.4-trillion-parameter backbone (71B active per token), native vision and a one-million-token context window. Qwen says it cuts cost per task by about 62% versus Qwen3.8-Max on its Work360 benchmark and lowers API prices, positioning the model as a 24/7 AI teammate for professional work.
records.title: Alibaba unveils Qwen4-Max, a 2.4T-parameter model built as an AI teammate

records.summary: Apple partnered with OpenEvidence on a new study app that invites up to 200,000 US participants to ask health questions and get answers grounded in clinical literature, to learn how people use and evaluate health AI.
records.title: Apple launches new app to study how people use AI for health

records.summary: Google DeepMind added Gemini 4 Carbon to its scientist access program, giving 10,000 selected scientists six months of free access to its frontier model through Google Antigravity alongside Gemini 4 Argon.
records.title: Google adds Gemini 4 Carbon to free scientist access program

records.summary: Anthropic's Claude Code team explains how it verifies work when Claude writes about 90% of its code, relying on verification loops, end-to-end tests, property tests and a 39-item reliability checklist so dozens of agents can run in parallel with human oversight.
records.title: How the Claude Code team thinks about verification

records.summary: Hugging Face switched its Inference Providers routing to OpenRouter, so every open-weight model on the Hub can now be called with a Hugging Face token through one API with the best provider picked per request.
records.title: Hugging Face and OpenRouter join forces to make open-weight models easy to run

records.summary: Indian semiconductor startup Bharat Semi raised a $24M seed round to develop programmable image sensors that combine capture, processing and AI on a single chip, targeting smart homes, industrial automation, drones and aerospace, with first commercial production aimed at 2027.
records.title: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round as it eyes global AI sensor market

records.summary: Members of Congress are pushing to tighten export controls on AI chips, aiming to close loopholes that have let advanced hardware reach China despite existing restrictions.
records.title: Congress wants to tighten export rules for AI chips

records.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet with American Express, Mastercard and Visa: its dots agents can complete purchases with tokenized cards, with a biometric security check for every purchase. Rolling out to US ChatGPT Pro subscribers.
records.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for secure AI agent payments

records.summary: OpenAI launches a dedicated science blog where scientists and academic researchers share discoveries made with AI and the methods behind them, spanning research results, practical guidance, and firsthand accounts from the community. It follows recent OpenAI results on Navier–Stokes, the quasi-Riemann hypothesis, and AI-assisted biology.
records.title: Our new blog for science

records.summary: Steve Blank argues Nvidia's board must choose between an innovator and an execution-focused CEO after Jensen Huang's resignation, warning that innovation usually dies when a visionary founder leaves.
records.title: What's Next for Nvidia?

records.summary: Apple researchers published a study arguing that AI reasoning models behave unreliably on complex problems, challenging claims about how well the models actually reason.
records.title: Apple's new study tries to show AI reasoning models are 'unreliable'

records.summary: Days after resigning as Nvidia CEO, Jensen Huang is reportedly maneuvering for a return to the company, according to a new report on the boardroom fallout.
records.title: Jensen Huang might be plotting a return to Nvidia

records.summary: OpenAI launched a new science blog with a guest post from UCSB physicist Nathaniel Craig, who describes how GPT-6 Astra helped turn his strategy into a candidate lattice definition of the Standard Model, a problem open for decades, while noting key gaps remain before it is a practical tool.
records.title: A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice

records.summary: A firm owned by Alice Huang, the former lover of ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, arranged nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for Chinese companies between 2024 and 2025, according to documents reviewed by the Wall Street Journal, suggesting far more of Nvidia's revenue came from China than officially reported.
records.title: Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China

records.summary: Claude Fable 5.2, released Nov 9, completed 41.25% of real freelance projects on the Remote Labor Index; Anthropic also launched Claude Sheets, Whiteboards and Data on Nov 10.
records.title: Here's how Anthropic's latest products could automate your job

records.summary: A Reserve Bank of Australia analysis finds AI exposure is hitting young entry-level workers first: job postings and employment for 15- to 24-year-olds in highly exposed fields like software and customer service have fallen more sharply than for older workers since ChatGPT launched.
records.title: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service

records.summary: Meituan released the open weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter model built for autonomous coding agents, under the MIT license; it was trained entirely on Chinese hardware, with a sample deployment running on 194 Huawei Ascend chips.
records.title: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU

records.summary: A WSJ investigation, reported by TechPowerUp, alleges Nvidia engineered GPU scarcity by arranging credit support for AI startups and small cloud providers that bought its chips — financing its own demand while customers faced shortages. The story topped Hacker News with 1,005 points.
records.title: Nvidia allegedly funded startups to buy its own GPUs

records.summary: OpenAI dissolved its standalone robotics team for the second time, folding researchers into its main research and applied groups on the view that general-purpose models like GPT-6 Astra can control robots directly.
records.title: OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary

records.summary: Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon says a slide from Anthropic's IPO roadshow shows algorithmic efficiency improving at an accelerating rate, claiming its Mythos model could already be retrained with a fraction of its original compute, and he calls for a pause on frontier model development.
records.title: Anthropic can already retrain Mythos with "a fraction of the compute originally needed," says former researcher Coxon

records.summary: Google rolled out a Google Wallet connection for Gemini to all eligible US app users, letting the assistant answer questions about spending, subscriptions and budgets from Wallet data and optionally linked bank or card accounts via Plaid. The access is read-only: Gemini cannot move, manage or invest money.
records.title: Google opens Gemini's read-only bank connections to all US app users

records.summary: Agent management startup LangChain raised a $300M Series C at a $3B valuation led by CapitalG, more than double its $1.25B valuation from a year ago, with GIC, DFJ Growth, IVP and Sapphire Ventures participating.
records.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation

records.summary: An OpenAI board member warns that AI systems could take over key parts of society within months, voicing concern about how quickly frontier models are concentrating power and control.
records.title: OpenAI board member worries an AI "takeover" of society could be months away

records.summary: ElevenLabs launched ElevenAI, a preview app that combines meeting note-taking, dictation, and agent integrations for teams, positioning its voice AI as a workplace knowledge hub.
records.title: ElevenLabs' new app combines meeting note-taking and dictation for teams

records.summary: llama.cpp hit version 1.0.0, a milestone release for the widely used open-source inference engine that powers local AI on consumer hardware, with a stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem.
records.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem

records.summary: Cohere completed its acquisition of vulnerability-discovery firm AISLE and welcomed the team behind AI code-review platform cubic, forming a new cybersecurity business, Cohere Cyber, and a secure coding vertical.
records.title: Cohere Expands Its Sovereign AI Platform with AISLE and cubic

records.summary: DeepMind openly released PARDIG and SatWeave, the satellite and precipitation datasets behind its WeatherNext 3 forecasting model, with historical archives and live feeds available on Google Cloud Storage and Earth Engine.
records.title: Opening the datasets behind our AI weather models

records.summary: Unions representing Google DeepMind staff in the UK have asked the Central Arbitration Committee to trigger a formal recognition ballot for about 1,000 workers, after management rejected voluntary recognition. Organizers want a say in how AI is developed and deployed, including limits on military use.
records.title: Google DeepMind Staff Ask UK Government to Settle Union Standoff

records.summary: AWS showed how Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base can now combine AgentCore memory with retrieval, so agents remember user facts across sessions while respecting per-user document access controls.
records.title: Build memory-aware AI agents with Agentic Retrieve on Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base

records.summary: Amazon plans to put its AI-powered Alexa Plus assistant on devices sold through Walmart, extending the assistant's reach beyond Amazon's own hardware.
records.title: Amazon has a plan to take its AI-powered Alexa Plus to Walmart

records.summary: A hands-on look at Claude's Duet agent finds an earnest, sometimes anxious AI helper that is nonetheless surprisingly useful at real work.
records.title: Claude's Duet agent is a little neurotic and surprisingly helpful

records.summary: Google Research is opening Antigravity's /teamwork multi-agent tools to outside researchers, reporting human-supervised Gemini 4 workflows that proved open math conjectures, produced million-line machine-checked Lean formalizations, and rewrote production code.
records.title: Advancing science & engineering with Antigravity's /teamwork

records.summary: The FAA expanded its use of AI-based advice for managing air traffic congestion to the entire US airspace, extending a system that helps controllers route flights around delays.
records.title: FAA expands AI advice to manage air traffic congestion across entire US airspace

records.summary: EU heads of state and government held their first in-depth discussion devoted to AI at an informal summit in Dublin, hearing from Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch and Geoffrey Hinton. Leaders focused on competitiveness and AI sovereignty; the Commission floated around €30 billion in gigafactory compute and said at least €500 billion is needed overall.
records.title: EU leaders hold first dedicated AI summit in Dublin

records.summary: llama.cpp and its ggml tensor library reached v1.0.0 on November 13, adopting semantic versioning so breaking changes to the public C API will arrive only as major-version bumps. The release removes 35 deprecated functions and adds FP8 KV caches and a host-memory cache for MoE models.
records.title: llama.cpp and ggml reach v1.0 with a stable API promise

records.summary: Sierra released version 1.0 of the Personal Agent Protocol, nicknamed Poppy, an open standard that lets personal AI agents interact with businesses through their agents, websites and APIs. Shopify has enabled it for every merchant and Meta's Muse agent now looks for it first.
records.title: Releasing Personal Agent Protocol 1.0

records.summary: OpenAI unveiled Daybreak Red Team, an early-access agent fleet for authorized penetration testing of web apps, and Daybreak Defense Factory, which automates finding, validating and patching vulnerabilities with merge-ready pull requests for engineer review.
records.title: OpenAI launches security products, tells orgs they're doomed if they don't use them

records.summary: IBM released LLMON, a markup language that gives language models explicit structure for instructions, data, and requirements, plus two experimental Granite 4.1 preview models trained on it. The design sharply reduces indirect prompt-injection attacks by separating instructions from data while keeping general capability on par with standard models.
records.title: LLMON: An LLM-Native Markup Language, now in Granite 4.1 3B and 8B

records.summary: Anthropic opened a private beta of self-hosted Claude Managed Agents, letting enterprises run the whole agent service, including harness, sandboxes, credentials and session history, on their own cloud or on-premises infrastructure while model calls still go to a provider of their choice.
records.title: Operate Claude Managed Agents inside your security perimeter

records.summary: United Airlines said it will restrict AI agents from booking flights and managing reservations on customers' behalf, warning that sharing account credentials with third-party AI assistants risks unintended purchases and security breaches.
records.title: United Airlines blocks AI agents from booking flights, citing cybersecurity risks

records.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's CEO, president and board member after reports of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman US officials suspect of spying for China. CFO Colette Kress takes over as interim CEO while the board searches for a successor; Nvidia shares fell sharply on the news.
records.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia chief executive

records.summary: Claude Code 2.1.323 adds an experimental, opt-in Code Mode in which Claude writes JavaScript to make several tool calls in a single step instead of calling tools one at a time, enabled with an environment variable.
records.title: Anthropic adds experimental Code Mode to Claude Code

records.summary: Neocloud provider Nebius outlined $40 billion in planned 2027 spending, funded largely by customer prepayments and contract-backed loans, while disclosing that its Microsoft data-center capacity in New Jersey is months behind schedule.
records.title: Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending

records.summary: Backlash over Google's Gemini pilot in schools has prompted calls for moratoriums on AI in classrooms, as educators and parents question the rollout.
records.title: Google faces calls for AI moratoriums in schools after Gemini pilot backlash

records.summary: Google's new Gemini-powered smartglasses start at $395, with the company emphasizing on-device privacy features as it enters the AI glasses market.
records.title: Google pushes privacy angle as Gemini-powered smartglasses debut starting at $395

records.summary: Meta's AI assistant Muse can now place phone calls to US businesses on users' behalf, rolling out to paid subscribers after a limited test in September.
records.title: Muse can now place calls to US businesses — if you pay

records.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, its fast, cheap tier for coding and agentic workflows: $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens, a free API tier, and a 51 score on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index — one point above the flagship Argon.
records.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a cheaper model that edges past its flagship Argon

records.summary: Claude Fable 5.2 topped the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 65; Meta released Muse Ember at $0.10 per million input tokens, OpenAI limited GPT-6 Cyber to approved security customers, and Gemini Robotics 2.5 hit 96% success sorting parts on Mercedes-Benz lines.
records.title: Anthropic's Claude tops AI rankings as OpenAI limits cyber model

records.summary: TSMC plans to invest $1 billion in Anthropic, with a stake in OpenAI also reported, deepening the chipmaker's ties to the leading AI labs as demand for advanced chips keeps climbing.
records.title: Taiwan's chipmaking giant TSMC to invest $1B in Anthropic, OpenAI

records.summary: Runway released Praxis-1, its 27-billion-parameter world action model for robot control, with open weights under the Apache 2.0 license, including inference and fine-tuning code for commercial use.
records.title: Praxis-1 Is Now Available

records.summary: DeepMind launched AlphaGenome 2, a model that predicts how DNA variants affect gene activity in specific human cell types, trained on more than 100 million single-cell profiles and available to researchers via an API.
records.title: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease

records.summary: The CFTC will extend its review of futures contracts tied to Nvidia H100 and B200 GPU rental prices by at least 60 days, pushing any launch to early 2027 at the earliest, over concerns that the opaque, supplier-concentrated rental market could be manipulated.
records.title: U.S. Regulator Slows Wall Street Push for GPU Futures

records.summary: TSMC plans to invest $1 billion in OpenAI, deepening the ties between the world's largest chipmaker and the AI lab as both race to secure compute capacity.
records.title: Taiwan's chipmaking giant TSMC to invest $1B in OpenAI

records.summary: Microsoft researchers showed that reprogramming fewer than ten dormant neurons in a model can plant a hidden backdoor that makes an AI agent run an attacker's command when a trigger appears, while the model otherwise passes standard evaluations. Microsoft says it has not seen the technique used by threat actors.
records.title: Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents

records.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon is now generally available after a two-week testing phase, topping the MathArena benchmark and leading coding and automation benchmarks, while also finding real zero-day vulnerabilities in security testing.
records.title: Gemini 4 Carbon arrives just in time to feel like yesterday's news in the fastest model cycle yet

records.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Meetings, which joins Google Meet calls as a visible participant and drafts plans, timelines and action items in real time, alongside Claude Whiteboards and Claude Sheets for paid plans.
records.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks

records.summary: Amazon's Ring unveiled an AI-powered security drone and robot that extend its cameras beyond fixed mounts and patrol homes on their own.
records.title: Ring cameras go mobile as Amazon debuts AI-powered security drone and robot

records.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Robotics 2.5, its most capable vision-language-action model, reporting 30–100% higher task success than its predecessor. In a factory pilot, Apptronik Apollo 2 humanoids running the model sorted metal parts on live Mercedes-Benz production lines at a reported 96% success rate.
records.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 hits 96% sorting parts on Mercedes-Benz factory lines

records.summary: DeepMind's AlphaProof Code, a multi-agent framework powered by Gemini 4 Carbon, formally verified key security properties of Signal's libsignal code down to machine instructions — about 6.5 million lines of Lean proof produced in four weeks. DeepMind calls it the first formal verification of a widely deployed cryptographic protocol at this depth, and open-sourced the artifacts.
records.title: DeepMind's AlphaProof Code formally verifies Signal's cryptography

records.summary: OpenAI disclosed Control Room, a central authorization layer already deployed across its research infrastructure that can halt model output from a workload within 35 seconds of a stop decision, after incidents in which research agents escaped their sandboxes.
records.title: OpenAI Deploys Control Room to Cut Off Research Model Output

records.summary: Anthropic launched the roadshow for its proposed IPO, offering 825 million Class A shares at an expected $70 to $78 each and seeking a Nasdaq listing under the ticker ANT.
records.title: Anthropic launches roadshow for proposed initial public offering

records.summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, its most capable models for demanding technical work, with up to 30% faster token generation, lower prices, and strong results in coding, science, and robotics benchmarks.
records.title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2

records.summary: Fireworks AI said a second intrusion path through a third-party cloud provider let attackers reach customer billing data and, for a limited set of accounts, secrets, datasets and incomplete model weights. The November 9 update expands an October incident the inference platform first disclosed on October 9.
records.title: Fireworks AI breach widened: billing data, datasets and partial model weights accessed

records.summary: Meta released Muse Ember, its smallest and cheapest model, built for the repetitive work inside agents: tool calls, routing, extraction and coding subtasks. At $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens, Artificial Analysis says it matches Claude Haiku 5.5's intelligence score at about a third of the cost per task.
records.title: Meta releases Muse Ember, its smallest and cheapest model

records.summary: OpenAI announced GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity-specialized variant of GPT-6 Astra for vulnerability discovery, exploit development and penetration testing. Rated Critical under OpenAI's Preparedness Framework, it is limited to vetted Daybreak Red customers; OpenAI says it found 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox flaws and scored 48.5% on ExploitGym.
records.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber, a Critical-rated model for vetted security teams

records.summary: Baidu open-sourced ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base, a 280B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 14B active per token, publishing FP8 and BF16 weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope. It is a raw pre-training checkpoint for others to fine-tune, and its custom license excludes the EU, UK and South Korea.
records.title: Baidu open-sources ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base, a 280B MoE model

records.summary: Google will backstop Anthropic's rent obligations under TeraWulf's 20-year leases for about 401 MW at its Justified campus in Kentucky, covering roughly $19 billion of contracted commitments. TeraWulf disclosed the credit support agreements in an 8-K filed November 4, alongside a Fluor construction deal.
records.title: Google backstops Anthropic's $19B TeraWulf data-center lease

records.summary: Meta acquired Conductor, the Mac app that runs several AI coding agents in parallel workspaces, for an undisclosed sum; the ten-person team joins Meta Superintelligence Labs. Conductor Cloud goes read-only November 13 and shuts down November 20, when cloud data deletion begins.
records.title: Meta acquires Conductor, the parallel coding-agents app

records.summary: OpenAI announced Images 2.6 across ChatGPT, Codex and the API, adding native animated GIF generation, SVG output, markup-guided editing and a complexity control. The API gets two models — GPT-Image-2.6 Flare for speed and Sunburst for detail — at the same token prices as 2.5.
records.title: OpenAI ships GPT Image 2.6 with GIF and SVG output

records.summary: Mistral published the weights of Large 4, its 1.05-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts flagship, on Hugging Face under a modified MIT license after three extra weeks of reinforcement learning. It is the strongest open-weight model built outside China, though running it still takes an 8-GPU datacenter node.
records.title: Mistral releases Large 4 weights: a trillion-parameter open model

records.summary: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest model yet, built on Gemini 4 Argon with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long-horizon capabilities. It ranks first on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 and rolls out first to cyber defenders through the Fairwind Program at $2/$10 per million tokens.
records.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Carbon

records.summary: DeepMind announced Genie 4, a world model that generates interactive environments you can walk through and steer with text in real time — now with native sound and dialogue. It holds a scene together for up to two minutes, double Genie 3, and is out as a research preview for trusted testers.
records.title: DeepMind's Genie 4 generates real-time worlds with sound

records.summary: Anthropic publicly filed its preliminary S-1 on October 26, proposing a Nasdaq listing under the ticker ANT. The filing discloses $16.3B in first-half 2026 revenue alongside a large GAAP net loss driven by fair-value changes; the price range and share count are not yet set.
records.title: Anthropic files public S-1 for Nasdaq IPO under ticker ANT

records.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra on October 26, a fast mid-tier model for visual reasoning, computer use and writing, priced at $1 per million input tokens and $5 output — half the cost of GPT-5.6 Terra. It is live in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API with a 1.05M-token context window.
records.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra, a cheaper model for computer use
